LanguageData.LP_Plane_NineHells.label: Nine Hells
LanguageData.LP_Plane_NineHells.description: The smell of sulfur and rust pours out of the rift: packs of hell hounds from the Nine Hells, and later ice devils walk out themselves.
LanguageData.LP_Plane_ElementalFire.label: Elemental Plane of Fire
LanguageData.LP_Plane_ElementalFire.description: Flames churn inside the rift: hell hounds charge out first, followed by fire genasi wreathed in flame.
LanguageData.LP_Plane_Feywild.label: Feywild
LanguageData.LP_Plane_Feywild.description: On the other side of the rift is an overly vivid forest: blink dogs and displacer beasts charge out together; they are mortal enemies of each other, and both want to bite you.
LanguageData.LP_Plane_Shadowfell.label: Shadowfell
LanguageData.LP_Plane_Shadowfell.description: Grey chill seeps from the rift: packs of winter wolves, and behind them an invisible displacer beast hidden in the shadows.
